Ready: Choose a folder or scan rules. Nothing is deleted automatically.
Busy: An operation is running. Cancel it and wait before closing.
Cancelled: Cancelled. Review the journal for completed work.
RootHint: Read-only scanning supports any mounted local drive or folder. Links are skipped.
ScanSummary: {0:N0} files · {1:F3} GiB · {2:N0} diagnostics. Sizes are logical, not guaranteed reclaimable.
DeleteConfirm: Execute {0:N0} selected file operations ({1:F3} GiB)? Deletions bypass the Recycle Bin. Copy/move destinations will be verified; moves then remove originals.
CleanupDone: Deleted {0:N0}; skipped {1:N0}; observed free-space change {2:F3} GiB.
TransferHint: Choose a new destination. Existing folders are never merged. Partial copies and journals remain after failure. Empty source folders remain.
PlanReady: Transfer preview ready: {0:N0} files, {1:F3} GiB. Review before executing.
KeyReady: A database-authenticated key is held in memory. Close the chat client before backing up or exporting.
ChatHint: Select your account. Capture a key while logged in if needed, then close the client. Raw backup preserves databases and media; readable export never authorizes source deletion.
SelectAccount: Select a discovered account or inspect its folder.
ExportDone: Exported {0:N0} records from {1} databases. Complete: {2}. Report: {3}
ChatBackupConfirm: Back up the entire selected account folder, including media, to {0}? The original data remains.
ActiveKeyConfirm: This explicit action starts a signed WeChat 4.x client under a separate debugger worker and waits up to 90 seconds for you to log in. Close daily WeChat first. The worker and its new client tree exit after capture, cancellation, or timeout. No existing client is attached and no key is saved. Only use your own selected account. Continue?
ExportNotice: Export may contain message text, XML, original binary payloads, and explicit unparsed entries. Media playback and all message variants are not guaranteed. Preserve and verify the full raw backup before any later deletion.
RulesGuide: Rules are local JSON data. AI can author rules using the schema and guide; import, scan, and review before execution. No chat data is uploaded.
RuleLoaded: Loaded {0} rules. Scan to review their matches.
NoRoot: Choose a source and a new destination folder.
Imported: Rules imported. Scan again before execution.
ChatArchiveNotice: Message text and raw payloads; media is preserved in the separate raw backup.
rule.user-temp.name: User temporary files
rule.user-temp.description: Keep files created or modified in the last seven days.
rule.windows-temp.name: Windows temporary files
rule.windows-temp.description: Only the Temp directory; inaccessible files are skipped without changing permissions.
rule.shader-cache.name: DirectX and NVIDIA shader cache
rule.shader-cache.description: Games may compile shaders again after cleanup.
rule.vscode-packages.name: VS Code extension packages
rule.vscode-packages.description: Keep installed extensions and settings; installers may be downloaded again.
rule.vscode-cache.name: VS Code render and code cache
rule.vscode-cache.description: Preserve User, Backups, sessions, and workspaces.
rule.vscode-dumps.name: VS Code crash dumps
rule.vscode-dumps.description: Deleting dumps removes evidence for the corresponding crashes.
rule.music-cache.name: NetEase Cloud Music cache
rule.music-cache.description: Only Cache/Cache; cached songs may need an Internet connection again.
rule.jetbrains-downloads.name: JetBrains Toolbox downloads
rule.jetbrains-downloads.description: Future installations and updates may download these files again.
rule.jetbrains-backups.name: JetBrains Toolbox previous versions
rule.jetbrains-backups.description: Removes the ability to roll back instantly to these previous versions.
rule.electron-updaters.name: Electron updater installers
rule.electron-updaters.description: Only EXE installers older than one day in *-updater directories; confirm the update has completed.
rule.edge-cache.name: Edge browser cache
rule.edge-cache.description: Preserve cookies, passwords, history, and site storage.
rule.chrome-cache.name: Chrome browser cache
rule.chrome-cache.description: Skip relocated junctions; preserve personal profile data.
rule.firefox-cache.name: Firefox browser cache
rule.firefox-cache.description: Only cache2 under local profile directories.
rule.nuget-http.name: NuGet HTTP cache
rule.nuget-http.description: Keep global packages; HTTP metadata may be downloaded again.
rule.npm-cache.name: npm download cache
rule.pip-cache.name: pip download cache
rule.pip-cache.description: Keep environments; use uv itself to manage its cache.
rule.yy-logs.name: YY old logs
rule.yy-logs.description: Only the log directory; preserve accounts and business data.
rule.yy-cache.name: YY resource cache
rule.yy-cache.description: Only the cache directory; resources may be downloaded again.
rule.wechat-logs.name: WeChat old logs
rule.wechat-logs.description: Preserve chat databases, pictures, and attachments.
rule.lghub-cache.name: Logitech G HUB cache
rule.lghub-cache.description: Only cache, not depots or device configuration.
rule.bilibili-cache.name: Bilibili browser cache
rule.bilibili-cache.description: Only browser caches, not downloaded videos.
rule.crash-dumps.name: Old crash dumps
rule.crash-dumps.description: Deleting dumps removes the corresponding diagnostic evidence.
rule.windows-reports.name: Windows error reports
rule.windows-reports.description: Only archived and queued error reports; inaccessible files are skipped.
